newsitem.title: USA: Marathon Texas refinery has hiccup Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Marathon Texas refinery has hiccup Thursday.

text.p: Marathon Oil Co's Texas City, Texas refinery suffered an unspecified valve leak Thursday which caused it to release volatile organic compounds, but the leak has since been repaired, regulators said.

"At 1540 (CST/1640 EST), yesterday we received a report of volatile organic compounds being released from a transmitter valve leak, but it was repaired within an hour," said a Texas environmental regulator.
The 70,000 barrel per day (bpd) refinery has catalytic cracking capacity of 34,000 bpd. Officials at Marathon, a unit of USX-Marathon Group, could not be immediately reached.
The regulator at the Texas Natural Resources Conservation Commission did not know the effect the valve trouble had on the refinery.
The valve trouble spurred speculation among oil traders of a larger problem with the Marathon refinery in light of recent problems that other other U.S. Gulf refineries have had.
Refinery runs are high as refineries pump distillate at record levels to replenish lean distillate stocks.
